messages:
Priya R: Quick question from yesterday's biz trip. Took a regional bus and only got a stamped paper ticket with amount. Can I submit a photo of the ticket? Also, I left at 3pm so should I claim full per diem or half?
Jordan (People Ops): Hi Priya :wave: Yes, photo of the ticket is acceptable for transport when no full invoice is available. Make sure date, route and amount are visible.
Maya (Finance): For per diem: our rule is full if away >12h, half for 6-12h, none for <6h. Leaving at 3pm typically qualifies as half day. Add a short note with your travel times in the expense.
Priya R: Got it. If the ticket is in local currency, should I convert or upload as-is?
Maya (Finance): Upload the original ticket image and enter the original currency in the form. The system will convert. If the card charge shows a slightly different amount, attach a screenshot of the bank charge to reconcile.
Priya R: Thanks! Submitted with photo + bank screenshot and note "regional bus, 15:00 departure".
ExpensesBot: Expense docs: https://company.docs/expenses/travel — Attach foreign receipts: https://company.docs/expenses/receipts
Jordan (People Ops): Thanks Priya, approved from People Ops. Finance will process payment after verification. :white_check_mark:
